value.name: Rosa silently reveals hidden mechanism
value.description: Rosa stops humming and works a recessed bead in the sideboard, causing a hidden latch to click open.
evidence: Rosa's humming thinned and stopped; she didn't answer, but her cloth slowed and then bore down on a small recessed bead in the lower panel, working it in tight circles a beat longer than any polishing required.
When her thumb pressed the bead flat against the grain, Asha heard the faint, dry click of something giving inside the wood

value.name: Asha realizes Rosa expected the question
value.description: Asha senses that Rosa had been waiting all morning for someone to ask about the hidden panel.
evidence: Asha understood, with a small cold drop in her stomach, that Rosa had been waiting all morning to be asked.

value.name: Asha opens hidden panel slightly
value.description: Asha touches the unlocked bead and opens the sideboard panel a small amount, revealing a smell of old cedar and paper.
evidence: Asha closed the distance to the sideboard and laid two fingers along the bead Rosa had worked, feeling the give where the wood had unlocked itself.
The panel swung out a finger's width under her hand, releasing a thin smell of old cedar and paper

value.name: Daniel interrupts discovery
value.description: Daniel enters the room and interrupts Asha's attempt to open the hidden compartment.
evidence: she had just begun to ease it open when Daniel's step sounded in the hall.
"What is taking so long in here?" he said, coming through the doorway with his coat still on

value.name: Asha conceals her discovery
value.description: Asha withdraws from the panel and pretends to steady herself while Rosa resumes polishing.
evidence: Asha let her fingers drift from the panel without closing it fully, resting her palm flat on the polished top as if she had only been steadying herself
and Rosa resumed her slow circles on a clean stretch of wood.

value.name: Daniel mentions buyers walkthrough
value.description: Daniel says the buyers want a walkthrough on Thursday, shifting the conversation toward the house sale.
